name: abuse
title: Abuse 2.00 (Crack dot Com, 1996): Debian 2.0's abuse 2.00-11, the Linux X11 build
fetch: mkdir -p corpus/abuse/debian-src corpus/abuse/debian-lib/x corpus/abuse/debian-lib/data && curl -Lo corpus/abuse/debian-src/abuse_2.00.orig.tar.gz http://archive.debian.org/debian/dists/hamm/main/source/games/abuse_2.00.orig.tar.gz && curl -Lo corpus/abuse/debian-src/abuse_2.00-11.diff.gz http://archive.debian.org/debian/dists/hamm/main/source/games/abuse_2.00-11.diff.gz && tar -xzf corpus/abuse/debian-src/abuse_2.00.orig.tar.gz -C corpus/abuse/debian-src && cp -R corpus/abuse/debian-src/abuse-2.00.orig corpus/abuse/debian-src/abuse-2.00 && gunzip -c corpus/abuse/debian-src/abuse_2.00-11.diff.gz | patch -p1 -d corpus/abuse/debian-src/abuse-2.00 && curl -Lo corpus/abuse/debian-lib/abuse-lib_2.00-5.deb http://archive.debian.org/debian/dists/hamm/main/binary-i386/games/abuse-lib_2.00-5.deb && (cd corpus/abuse/debian-lib/x && ar x ../abuse-lib_2.00-5.deb) && tar -xzf corpus/abuse/debian-lib/x/data.tar.gz -C corpus/abuse/debian-lib/data
_doc: Crack dot Com's own source, released to the public domain in 1997, as Debian 2.0 (hamm) built it: abuse_2.00.orig.tar.gz with Debian's abuse_2.00-11.diff.gz applied, as dpkg-source -x does -- the source of the abuse 2.00-11 binary that MIRAGE-LINUX can run, the cross-oracle. The patch is Joey Hess's (1997) and is what let Debian ship the game without Bobby Prince's non-free sound effects: the release's cache.c exits when a .wav is missing, the patched one goes on; it also pins PATH/ABUSE_PATH (the binary was setgid games) and drops a mem_report that crashed without sound. The shareware levels, art and Lisp are Debian's abuse-lib 2.00-5 (public domain, Dave Taylor's 1997 letter in its copyright file).
_units: abuse/Makefile.am's abuse_x11R6_SOURCES, and the imlib libraries it links (imlib/Makefile.am) as configure picks them on Linux: libimage, libgui, libpacket, libdir (port/unix/jdir.c), libtime (port/unix/timing.c), libsound (readwav.c + port/sgi/sound.c -- configure's choice for *-linux, the SGI driver talking to lnx_sdrv), libjoy (port/linux/joystick.c), libwinman (port/x11). Not libnet (port/unix/jnet.c): abuse_x11R6_LDADD's IMLIBS does not link it, and listing it defined net_uninit twice.
_include: abuse/Makefile.am's INCLUDES, then imlib's own (-I include).

compile._cxx: Every unit is a .c compiled by $(CXX): the Makefiles' COMPILE rule.

_defines: MYDEFS (MANAGE_MEM, NO_CHECK), and what configure finds on Debian 2.0: HAVE_ATEXIT (AC_CHECK_FUNCS(atexit on_exit, break) stops at the first). NOT NO_XSHM: configure looks for XShmAttach in libXext first, and finds it, so the MIT-SHM path is compiled in; PRISM's X server then says the extension is absent at run time, as a remote server would, and Abuse takes XPutImage. __linux__ as gcc predefines it on Linux: Abuse tests it (6 places).
_args: debian/wrapper's: -nosound when /var/lib/games/abuse/sfx is absent, which it is (abuse-sfx is non-free).
